entries.land_description: Chandelier is working to establish a womon's retreat on 12 acres of wooded Florida wilds situated on beautiful Star Lake, 30 minutes from a university town. We are interested in investors, managers, womon to work and play. We wish to expand our boundaries and preserve a beautiful environment for women. We have a 2-bedroom home, a cabin, RV/camping, and are creating a kitchen house.

entries.land_description: Spiraland is 250 acres in the foothills of south-central Kentucky in the Cumberland Valley. Covering a ridge and valley of forest and cleared land, it includes three springs, a good barn, an old log cabin, two new homes, and future dwellings wimmin are building. Spiral is based on permaculture principles enhancing the diversity and abundance of life forms, preserving and building the soil, and working with the cycles and forces of nature. Spiral women share skills, especially the nontraditional trades of carpentry, plumbing, electric work and auto mechanics.

entries.community_name: SUSAN B ANTHONY MEMORIAL UNREST HOME
entries.land_description: (10 miles from Ohio University in Athens). Women's residential community in beautiful hills of Appalachian Ohio. Scenic camping. Pond for swimming. Older women especially welcome. Two women employed full time, one recently retired. All three are active feminists/liberationists.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (if negotiated ahead), cats
entries.notes: Two dogs, three cats. No cars permitted beyond gravel parking area except for differently abled. We have an outdoor place (under barn roof) that groups can rent for workshops or special women's events. We are/have: housing/permanent structures, plumbing and electricity (in the house only), woods, farmland, primitive camping space, women living on the land.

entries.num_residents: around 120 members (the great majority are lesbians)
entries.land_description: DOE Farm is an 11-year-old Womyn's land coop. Much of this rolling, secluded land is wooded. There's a campground area, an open-sided shelter, drinking water, outhouses, a rain barrel shower, a wood-heated sauna. Communal spaces and part of the campground are chemical free. We are working to make the land as accessible to differently-abled women as possible. Only members may camp.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, dogs
entries.notes: We are/have: housing/permanent structures, accessible, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
